# T16 — Candidate solutions (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Candidates

- **C1 — Extend the one procedures capability.** `procedures.ingest_sop`, `ingest_rdf` and
  `ingest_process` write typed drafts into the one store; a human gate publishes; bound jobs run
  the PDDL steps. **Chosen.**
- **C2 — A separate ingestion service with its own store.** Rejected.
- **C3 — Vendor SOP tooling with no record rows.** Rejected.
- **C4 — Ungated knowledge upload.** Rejected.

## Criteria

One model and one store; a human publication gate; versioned re-ingest; multi-format intake
(SOP, RDF/OWL, BPMN/Visio/draw.io); bound PDDL execution; audit rows for every write.

## Options rejected

- **C2** forks truth into a second store and puts the programme's blast radius across two systems;
  it also has no single audit trail.
- **C3** creates bespoke tooling with no action registry row, so no gate and no evidence.
- **C4** lets an unreviewed source bind a job — exactly what SPEC_V2 §12 T16 forbids. The delivered
  gate refuses it in `an_unreviewed_source_cannot_bind`.
title: T16 — Candidate solutions (retrospective, 2026-11-23)
